verses.original: Καὶ ἔδειξέν μοι ποταμὸν ὕδατος ζωῆς λαμπρὸν ὡς κρύσταλλον ἐκπορευόμενον ἐκ τοῦ θρόνου τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ τοῦ Ἀρνίου
verses.transliteration: Kai edeixen moi potamon hydatos zōēs lampron hōs krystallon ekporeuomenon ek tou thronou tou Theou kai tou Arniou
verses.literal: Then [the angel] showed me a river of the water of life as clear as crystal flowing from the throne - of God and of the Lamb

verses.original: ἐν μέσῳ τῆς πλατείας αὐτῆς καὶ ἐντεῦθεν καὶ ἐκεῖθεν τοῦ ποταμοῦ ξύλον ζωῆς ποιοῦν δώδεκα καρποὺς ἀποδιδοῦν αὐτοῦ τὸν καρπὸν κατὰ ἕκαστον μῆνα καὶ τὰ φύλλα τοῦ ξύλου εἰς θεραπείαν τῶν ἐθνῶν
verses.transliteration: en mesō tēs plateias autēs kai enteuthen kai ekeithen tou potamou xylon zōēs poioun dōdeka karpous apodidoun autou ton karpon kata hekaston mēna kai ta phylla tou xylou eis therapeian tōn ethnōn
verses.literal: down the middle of the main street of [the city] - On either side . . . . . . of the river stood a tree of life bearing twelve kinds of fruit [and] yielding [a fresh] - crop for each month And the leaves of the tree [are] for [the] healing of the nations

verses.original: Καὶ οὐκ ἔτι ἔσται πᾶν κατάθεμα καὶ ὁ θρόνος τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ τοῦ Ἀρνίου ἔσται ἐν αὐτῇ καὶ αὐτοῦ οἱ δοῦλοι λατρεύσουσιν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Kai ouk eti estai pan katathema kai ho thronos tou Theou kai tou Arniou estai en autē kai autou hoi douloi latreusousin autō
verses.literal: - No longer will there be any curse - The throne - of God and of the Lamb will be within [the city] and His - servants will worship Him

verses.original: καὶ ὄψονται αὐτοῦ τὸ πρόσωπον καὶ αὐτοῦ τὸ ὄνομα ἐπὶ αὐτῶν τῶν μετώπων
verses.transliteration: kai opsontai autou to prosōpon kai autou to onoma epi autōn tōn metōpōn
verses.literal: - They will see His - face and His - name [will be] on their - foreheads

verses.original: καὶ ἔσται οὐκ νὺξ ἔτι καὶ ἔχουσιν οὐκ χρείαν φωτὸς λύχνου καὶ φωτὸς ἡλίου ὅτι Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς φωτίσει ἐπ’ αὐτούς καὶ βασιλεύσουσιν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων
verses.transliteration: kai estai ouk nyx eti kai echousin ouk chreian phōtos lychnou kai phōtos hēliou hoti Kyrios ho Theos phōtisei ep’ autous kai basileusousin eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn
verses.literal: - There will be no more night [in the city] and they will have no need for [the] light of a lamp [or] - of [the] sun For [the] Lord - God will shine on them and they will reign vvv vvv forever [and] ever

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπέν μοι Οὗτοι οἱ λόγοι πιστοὶ καὶ ἀληθινοί καὶ ὁ Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς τῶν πνευμάτων τῶν προφητῶν ἀπέστειλεν αὐτοῦ τὸν ἄγγελον δεῖξαι αὐτοῦ τοῖς δούλοις ἃ δεῖ ἐν τάχει γενέσθαι
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen moi Houtoi hoi logoi pistoi kai alēthinoi kai ho Kyrios ho Theos tōn pneumatōn tōn prophētōn apesteilen autou ton angelon deixai autou tois doulois ha dei en tachei genesthai
verses.literal: Then [the angel] said to me These - words [are] faithful and true - The Lord the God of the spirits of the prophets has sent His - angel to show His - servants what must vvv soon take place

verses.original: Καὶ ἰδοὺ ἔρχομαι ταχύ μακάριος ὁ τηρῶν τοὺς λόγους τῆς προφητείας τοῦ τούτου βιβλίου
verses.transliteration: Kai idou erchomai tachy makarios ho tērōn tous logous tēs prophēteias tou toutou bibliou
verses.literal: - Behold I am coming soon Blessed [is] the [one who] keeps the words of prophecy in this book

verses.original: Κἀγὼ Ἰωάννης ὁ ἀκούων καὶ βλέπων ταῦτα καὶ ὅτε ἤκουσα καὶ ἔβλεψα ἔπεσα προσκυνῆσαι ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ποδῶν τοῦ ἀγγέλου τοῦ δεικνύοντός μοι ταῦτα
verses.transliteration: Kagō Iōannēs ho akouōn kai blepōn tauta kai hote ēkousa kai eblepsa epesa proskynēsai emprosthen tōn podōn tou angelou tou deiknyontos moi tauta
verses.literal: And I John [am] the [one who] heard and saw these things And when I had heard and seen [them] I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown me these things

verses.original: καὶ λέγει μοι Ὅρα μή εἰμι σύνδουλός σού καὶ τῶν σου ἀδελφῶν τῶν προφητῶν καὶ τῶν τηρούντων τοὺς λόγους τούτου τοῦ βιβλίου προσκύνησον τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: kai legei moi Hora mē eimi syndoulos sou kai tōn sou adelphōn tōn prophētōn kai tōn tērountōn tous logous toutou tou bibliou proskynēson tō Theō
verses.literal: [But] he said to me Do not do that . . . I am a fellow servant with you and - your brothers the prophets and with those who keep the words of this - book Worship - God

verses.original: Καὶ λέγει μοι Μὴ σφραγίσῃς τοὺς λόγους τῆς προφητείας τούτου τοῦ βιβλίου γὰρ ὁ καιρὸς ἐστιν ἐγγύς
verses.transliteration: Kai legei moi Mē sphragisēs tous logous tēs prophēteias toutou tou bibliou gar ho kairos estin engys
verses.literal: Then he told me vvv Do not seal up the words of prophecy in this - book because the time is near

verses.original: ὁ ἀδικῶν ἀδικησάτω ἔτι καὶ ὁ ῥυπαρὸς ῥυπανθήτω ἔτι καὶ ὁ δίκαιος ποιησάτω ἔτι δικαιοσύνην καὶ ὁ ἅγιος ἁγιασθήτω ἔτι
verses.transliteration: ho adikōn adikēsatō eti kai ho rhyparos rhypanthētō eti kai ho dikaios poiēsatō eti dikaiosynēn kai ho hagios hagiasthētō eti
verses.literal: {Let} the unrighteous continue to be unrighteous . . . and the vile continue to be vile . . . {let} the righteous continue to practice . . . righteousness and the holy continue to be holy . . .

verses.original: Ἰδοὺ ἔρχομαι ταχύ καὶ μου ὁ μισθός μετ’ ἐμοῦ ἀποδοῦναι ἑκάστῳ ὡς ἐστὶν τὸ αὐτοῦ ἔργον
verses.transliteration: Idou erchomai tachy kai mou ho misthos met’ emou apodounai hekastō hōs estin to autou ergon
verses.literal: Behold I am coming soon and My - reward [is] with Me to give to each one according to . . . what he has done

verses.original: ἐγὼ τὸ Ἄλφα καὶ τὸ Ὦ ὁ πρῶτος καὶ ὁ ἔσχατος ἡ ἀρχὴ καὶ τὸ τέλος
verses.transliteration: egō to Alpha kai to Ō ho prōtos kai ho eschatos hē archē kai to telos
verses.literal: I [am] the Alpha and the Omega the First and the Last the Beginning and the End

verses.original: Μακάριοι οἱ πλύνοντες αὐτῶν τὰς στολὰς ἵνα αὐτῶν ἔσται ἡ ἐξουσία ἐπὶ τὸ ξύλον τῆς ζωῆς καὶ εἰσέλθωσιν εἰς τὴν πόλιν τοῖς πυλῶσιν
verses.transliteration: Makarioi hoi plynontes autōn tas stolas hina autōn estai hē exousia epi to xylon tēs zōēs kai eiselthōsin eis tēn polin tois pylōsin
verses.literal: Blessed [are] those who wash their - robes so that they may have the right to the tree - of life and may enter . . . the city by [its] gates

verses.original: ἔξω οἱ κύνες καὶ οἱ φάρμακοι καὶ οἱ πόρνοι καὶ οἱ φονεῖς καὶ οἱ εἰδωλολάτραι καὶ πᾶς φιλῶν καὶ ποιῶν ψεῦδος
verses.transliteration: exō hoi kynes kai hoi pharmakoi kai hoi pornoi kai hoi phoneis kai hoi eidōlolatrai kai pas philōn kai poiōn pseudos
verses.literal: [But] outside [are] the dogs - the sorcerers - the sexually immoral - the murderers - the idolaters and everyone who loves and practices falsehood

verses.original: Ἐγὼ Ἰησοῦς ἔπεμψα μου τὸν ἄγγελόν μαρτυρῆσαι ὑμῖν ταῦτα ἐπὶ ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ ῥίζα καὶ τὸ γένος Δαυίδ ὁ ὁ λαμπρός ὁ πρωϊνός ἀστὴρ
verses.transliteration: Egō Iēsous epempsa mou ton angelon martyrēsai hymin tauta epi tais ekklēsiais egō eimi hē rhiza kai to genos Dauid ho ho lampros ho prōinos astēr
verses.literal: I Jesus have sent My - angel to give you this testimony . . . . . . for the churches I am the Root and the Offspring of David the - bright - Morning Star

verses.original: Καὶ τὸ Πνεῦμα καὶ ἡ νύμφη λέγουσιν Ἔρχου καὶ ὁ ἀκούων εἰπάτω Ἔρχου καὶ ὁ διψῶν ἐρχέσθω ὁ θέλων ὕδωρ ζωῆς λαβέτω δωρεάν
verses.transliteration: Kai to Pneuma kai hē nymphē legousin Erchou kai ho akouōn eipatō Erchou kai ho dipsōn erchesthō ho thelōn hydōr zōēs labetō dōrean
verses.literal: - The Spirit and the bride say Come - {Let} the [one who] hears say Come And {let} the [one who] is thirsty come [and] the [one who] desires [the] water of life [drink] freely

verses.original: ἐγὼ Μαρτυρῶ παντὶ τῷ ἀκούοντι τοὺς λόγους τῆς προφητείας τούτου τοῦ βιβλίου ἐάν τις ἐπιθῇ ἐπ’ αὐτά ὁ Θεὸς ἐπιθήσει ἐπ’ αὐτὸν τὰς πληγὰς τὰς γεγραμμένας ἐν τούτῳ τῷ βιβλίῳ
verses.transliteration: egō Martyrō panti tō akouonti tous logous tēs prophēteias toutou tou bibliou ean tis epithē ep’ auta ho Theos epithēsei ep’ auton tas plēgas tas gegrammenas en toutō tō bibliō
verses.literal: I testify to everyone who hears the words of prophecy in this - book If anyone adds to [them] - God will add to him the plagues - described in this - book

verses.original: καὶ ἐάν τις ἀφέλῃ ἀπὸ τῶν λόγων ταύτης τοῦ βιβλίου τῆς προφητείας ὁ Θεὸς ἀφελεῖ αὐτοῦ τὸ μέρος ἀπὸ τοῦ ξύλου τῆς ζωῆς καὶ ἐκ τῆς τῆς ἁγίας πόλεως τῶν γεγραμμένων ἐν τούτῳ τῷ βιβλίῳ
verses.transliteration: kai ean tis aphelē apo tōn logōn tautēs tou bibliou tēs prophēteias ho Theos aphelei autou to meros apo tou xylou tēs zōēs kai ek tēs tēs hagias poleōs tōn gegrammenōn en toutō tō bibliō
verses.literal: And if anyone takes away from the words of this - book - of prophecy - God will take away his - share in the tree - of life and - the - holy city which [are] described in this - book

verses.original: ὁ μαρτυρῶν ταῦτα Λέγει Ναί ἔρχομαι ταχύ Ἀμήν ἔρχου Κύριε Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: ho martyrōn tauta Legei Nai erchomai tachy Amēn erchou Kyrie Iēsou
verses.literal: He who testifies to these things says Yes I am coming soon Amen Come Lord Jesus

verses.original: Ἡ χάρις τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ μετὰ πάντων ἁγίων Ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: Hē charis tou Kyriou Iēsou meta pantōn hagiōn Amēn
verses.literal: The grace of the Lord Jesus [be] with all the saints Amen
